requirement.normalizedRequirement: Compute C_spex = max(0.3, 0.7*(1 - ((4*EAR)/Z)^3)) and Q_sex_kNm = max(C_LE0.8, 0.8*C_TE0.8)*C_spex*F_ex_kN, unless an appropriate stress analysis directly determines the maximum spindle torque.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The maximum spindle torque due to a blade-failure load acting at 0.8R shall be determined by appropriate stress analysis or Q_sex = max(C_LE0.8, 0.8*C_TE0.8)*C_spex*F_ex [kNm] (6.36), where C_spex = C_sp*C_fex = 0.7*(1 - ((4*EAR)/Z)^3) (6.37). If C_spex is below 0.3, a value of 0.3 shall be used. C_LE0.8 and C_TE0.8 are the leading-edge and trailing-edge portions of chord length at 0.8R.
